title: Your ten pages, outlined
headline: The storyteller has outlined the ten pages for the room: what the team made first, then how, the rule that let it go fast, what did not work, why it matters to you, and five steps to start tomorrow. The publisher writes them in your voice at 18:47; security reads them against six checks before I say they are ready to share. The PDF comes tonight.

head: Page
What it says
rows: A team of agents made a talk in a day: a repository after midnight, by evening a talk of 58 beats, its slides, its player and the site
What they made: the talk is a website, every slide a page that moves
How you can see everything they did: the record of every step
Meet the team: one job each, written down, like a cast
How a day runs: turns on a clock, through the night; plan, check, work, check
The rule that let them go fast: anyone could stop everything, only you could restart it; the hold at 18:44
What did not work: the talk needed more rounds; some claims did not hold, and the team's own checks found them
Why this matters to you: no code needed; a brief, plain rules, a loop, ship and repeat
Start tomorrow: five steps, from an empty repository to a second agent
Where the book goes next: the six parts, as a map
